body:
Hey @everyone. Time to announce the winners of the Tavern build contest!

  • 🥇1st Place: @NetworkGremlin and @gabreno! Your warp is set as `Tavern1`.

  • 🥈 2nd Place: @J_, @Starmarsh, and @Daria! Your warp is set as `Mycobarrow`.

  • 🥉 3rd Place: A tie!

    • @J1mbers! Your warp is set as `DeadEnd`.

    • @Cubic and @nate! Your warp is set as `JourneysEnd`.

Thanks so much to all who submitted. Your prize bundles are in your ender chests, and lemme know if you want your warps renamed!

🫶
